verdict.rationale: MotherDuck offers separate pieces that touch this story—SQL querying via CLI/UI, scheduled Python jobs ('Flights'), and AI-generated chart dashboards ('Dives')—but there's no evidence of a first-party notebook interface that lets an analyst interleave SQL and Python cells with inline results/charts in one document. Dives are AI-prompt-driven dashboards, not code notebooks, and Flights are scheduled batch jobs rather than interactive analysis. missing for 10: a unified notebook UI mixing SQL+Python cells, inline chart rendering within that notebook, and any independent/hands-on confirmation of such a workflow.
